minutes.headline: Committee reorganized with all members present but one, and held off changing COVID mask rules until the June 2 meeting.
minutes.summary: The committee went into executive session for union negotiation strategy, then returned for routine business. It heard a special education program evaluation and state determination, reorganized (chair, vice chair, secretary, committee slate), accepted a small donation, and discussed new state COVID guidance, deciding to take more time and survey parents. The paraprofessional contract ratification was tabled to the next meeting.

what_happened.line: The School Committee reorganized, electing a chair, vice chair and secretary by roll call, and continued all existing policies by a 4-0 vote.
The committee made no change to mask or cleaning protocols and asked administration to bring any proposals to the June 2 meeting.
Ratification of the paraprofessional contract was tabled to the next meeting on the business manager's recommendation.
Members asked that parents be surveyed about comfort with removing masks outdoors, after hearing updated state COVID guidance.
The committee heard a special education program evaluation and state determination, and accepted a Box Tops donation to the Turkey Hill gift account.

why_it_matters: The paraprofessional contract is a staffing cost that residents' taxes fund, and it stays unratified until the next meeting.
Mask and cleaning rules in schools stay as they are until at least June 2, and parents may be surveyed before any change.
watch_next: June 2 meeting: administration's mask and cleaning proposals, and the tabled paraprofessional contract ratification.
Updated DESE guidance and committee assignments are set for the next agenda.
